# Biggest Tech Stock Declines

The average public tech company's stock price is down 37.1% from its 52-week high. 64% of public tech companies are down at least 25% from their 52-week high. 29% of public tech companies are down at least 50%. 7% of public tech companies (66 companies) are down at least 75%.
